premise: 2071. Eleven years after the Blackout Winter took the satellites down, the only long-range signal left runs through the Relay: a chain of ground stations along the Saltline coast. Whoever holds the relays holds trade, power and the news everyone lives by.

season.name: Season 0 — Static
season.text: Ember crews have started jamming the Relay from inside the stations. The Directive has pulled every squad to the coast. Every match is a skirmish for one relay site: hold it, and the signal is yours for another night.

factions.name: Aegis Directive
factions.motto: Hold the line. Keep the signal.
factions.text: A security directive hired by the coast cities to guard the Relay. Drilled, well supplied, and paid in access fees that the inland towns can't afford. They keep the lights on — for whoever pays.

factions.name: Ember Syndicate
factions.text: Salvage crews from the inland scrap towns, shut out of the Relay by Directive tariffs. They strip stations for parts and jam the signal to force a new deal. They fight for the people left in the dark — and break what everyone needs.
